notes: Image-style presets backported from infiniteworlds.app. composer.ts buildImagePrompt already wraps outcome.visualVariables in imageStyle{Character,NonCharacter}{Pre,Post}; these presets give world authors a one-click named preset instead of hand-authoring the four strings. applyPreset() in src/engine/imageStylePresets.ts applies a preset's strings to a World.
scope: Trimmed 2026-07-30 on user direction: 12 presets -> 4 (none, photorealistic, pseudorealistic-cgi, anime). User feedback: 'Photorealistic' presets are not that different when used (image quality mostly depends on how well the image prompt is explained); the hidden gem is Pseudorealistic CGI which can produce both photoreal and anime flavours with the right instructions. The catalog is now lean to avoid choice-paralysis.
sources: Live recon on https://infiniteworlds.app via browser-use (2026-07-28): confirmed the IW 'Select image model' modal exposes Manticore / Wyvern / Flux image providers with a per-style <select> dropdown and a per-row 'Customise style' affordance that reveals four prompt-template textareas labelled imageStyleCharacterPre, imageStyleCharacterPost, imageStyleNonCharacterPre, imageStyleNonCharacterPost. Anvil's form-engine does not respond to JS-dispatched change events, so per-preset textarea strings beyond the College-of-Magic ones were not directly captured; the preset strings below use the standard IW tag-token conventions (IW<Tokens>) demonstrated in the captured real-world schema.

Real IW-exported world at docs/college_of_magic_schema.json: contains live 'photorealistic'-flavour strings for the four imageStyle*Pre/Post fields. Used verbatim for the 'photorealistic' preset -- these are exactly the strings users see on IW when they select Photorealistic 1 (Default) under Manticore. The preset id was renamed from 'photorealistic-1' to 'photorealistic' when the catalog was trimmed (the per-preset differentiation was not useful in practice).

presets.label: Default (no preset)
presets.description: Pass the LLM's raw visual prompt straight to the image model -- IW's 'no style selected' baseline. Yields the flat scenic look the user wants to improve.

presets.label: Photorealistic
presets.description: IW Manticore / Flux default -- gives the camera-photo close-up look. Most accurate for character-driven scenes. Strings verbatim from the College-of-Magic IW export.
presets.imageStyleCharacterPre: Highly attractive, sexy medium close-up photograph of
presets.imageStyleCharacterPost: Authentic period medieval clothing. IWBeautiful IWBeautiful2 Smooth, flawless skin and a perfect face. Looking at the viewer. IWUpscaleFaceSmooth Setting: Medieval magical high fantasy.
presets.imageStyleNonCharacterPost: High quality photograph. Setting: Medieval high fantasy.

presets.label: Pseudorealistic CGI
presets.description: Hidden gem -- halfway between photography and a high-end 3D render (Unreal/Octane). With well-explained prompts it can produce both photoreal and anime-styled frames, so it's the most flexible single-preset choice for users who don't want to flip presets per scene.
presets.imageStyleCharacterPost: High-end 3D render, Octane-quality subsurface skin, perfectly-lit shot-reverse-shot framing. IWPhotorealistic IWCGI Looking at the viewer. Impeccable detail.
presets.imageStyleNonCharacterPost: High-end 3D render, Octane-quality lighting and materials. IWCGI IWPhotorealistic Impeccable detail.

presets.label: Anime
presets.description: Manticore / Flux Anime. Modern anime cel-shaded look with vibrant hair and detailed eyes. Accurate and self-contained.
presets.imageStyleCharacterPost: Anime cel shading, vibrant detailed hair, large expressive eyes. IWAnime Anime key visual quality. Looking at the viewer.
presets.imageStyleNonCharacterPost: Anime cel shading, vibrant colour palette. IWAnime Anime background art quality.
